aviso: SYNTHETIC DATA for demonstration. Blood baselines seeded from real NASA OSDR Inspiration4 crew; drifts from NASA HRP evidence reports and labeled assumptions.

eventos.descripcion: Prodrome days 141–146 (rising HR and BP, poor sleep). Day 147: chest pain, hypotension, tachycardia, low SpO2.
Mood and sleep decline days 110–160 (isolation and confinement).
38.3–38.6 °C on days 71–72, compatible with latent viral reactivation.
+20 mSv in one day for the whole crew.

Informe HRP: < 0.9 mSv/día en superficie planetaria
